{"metadata":{"description":"Declarative deny-by-default tool policy plugin for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333196543","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tool-policy","slug":"Drifter-yh/dsh-tool-policy","topics":["agent","agent-infrastructure","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","tool-policy"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Declarative deny-by-default tool policy plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tool-policy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that applies **allow, ask, or deny** rules to tool calls before they execu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"eepSeek Harness plugin that applies **allow, ask, or deny** rules to tool calls before they execute."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It provides a declarative, deny-by-default policy layer for built-in, third-party, and MCP tools, wh"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ile reusing Harness's existing approval and sandbox mechanisms. It is a per-call policy layer, not a"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" capability sandbox."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> Community plugin. Not affiliated with or maintained by DeepSeek AI."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Repository: Drifter-yh/dsh-tool-policy"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why this is needed"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness already has strong primitives for tool execution: sandbox policy, one-shot approval"},{"id":"p9s2","text":", cooperative timeouts, provider retries, repeat-call reminders, and session telemetry. What is miss"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ing is a deployment-owned policy layer that applies the same rule vocabulary to every tool, includin"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"g third-party and MCP tools."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Typical uses include:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- allow selected tool namespaces or families such as `read_*`;
- require human approval for MCP or o"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ther external tools such as `mcp__*`;
- deny a known destructive command pattern before the matched "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"tool body starts;
- run a deny-by-default tool-call allowlist for unattended jobs;
- keep sensitive "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"argument values out of policy feedback messages."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A typical call path looks like this:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The plugin is intentionally not an audit logger or approval implementation. The Harness already owns"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" intentionally not an audit logger or approval implementation. The Harness already owns those seams."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin operates on individual tool calls. Its rules match observable tool names and optional arg"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ument patterns before the tool body runs:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Harness sandbox — capability enforcement:** Can this agent perform this class of operation at al"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"l? Harness sandboxing and runtime isolation are the layers responsible for enforcing capabilities su"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ch as filesystem writes or deletes, network access, and process execution.
- **dsh-tool-policy — per"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"-call policy / routing:** Should this particular known tool call be allowed, denied, or escalated? A"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" matching `deny` prevents that call from executing; it does not revoke the underlying capability.
- "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"**Harness Approval — human escalation verdict:** Should an escalated `ask` call receive a one-shot h"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"roval — human escalation verdict:** Should an escalated `ask` call receive a one-shot human verdict?"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"A rule that matches one shell argument pattern, such as `rm -rf /foo`, only governs that call shape."},{"id":"p18s2","text":" A different tool or command sequence may produce the same effect. Tool policy and capability sandbo"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"xing are therefore complementary layers; production deployments should combine policy routing with a"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" restrictive Harness sandbox."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### What this does not do"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`dsh-tool-policy` does not implement sandboxing, capability enforcement, shell semantic analysis, or"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" equivalent-operation detection. A `deny` rule makes the matched call unavailable, not destructive b"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ehavior impossible in general. It does not rewrite arguments or execute tool bodies."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> The official npm package for this project is `@drifter-yh/dsh-tool-policy`.
>
> The"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" unscoped npm package `dsh-tool-policy` is maintained by a different third-party project and is not "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"published from this repository.
>
> Use the scoped package name when installing from npm."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The recorded validation baseline uses the public Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` package line:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The Harness packages are peer dependencies so the host controls the runtime version. `@deepseek-ai/s"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"chemastery` is installed as the plugin's normal runtime dependency. This package is tested against t"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"he public `0.1.1-rc.2` registry artifacts."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The example pins the two direct Harness peers, but does not reproduce the full CI lockfile. See CONT"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"RIBUTING.md for the locked development baseline."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### GitHub installation"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The upstream profile-plugin documentation supports installing a TypeScript bundle directly from GitH"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" upstream profile-plugin documentation supports installing a TypeScript bundle directly from GitHub:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The plugin uses only `inject: ['tools']` and `ctx.on('tools/pre-execute', ...)`. Cordis owns listene"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"r disposal and reload behavior. The plugin does not patch `ToolRuntime` or `agent-loop`."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Compatibility with DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin declares the `dsh-tools` peer range `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0 || 0.1.1-rc.2` and Cordis `>=4.0"},{"id":"p35s2","text":".1 <5`. It is currently validated against the published `0.1.1-rc.2` registry packages and upstream "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"tag `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2` at commit `b150a551b8d465e31e418e1b2eaf5e79bbb7d28e`. Its Harness-specific cod"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"e uses the documented `Context`, `tools` service, and `tools/pre-execute` event only. Peer ranges ca"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"nnot establish compatibility or detect API drift within those ranges."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The package's `dsh.bundle.patch` metadata follows the Harness profile-bundle specification. `cordis."},{"id":"p36s2","text":"patch.yml` inserts the plugin by its module/package name, and profile composition applies that layer"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" before the profile's own patch. The bundle defaults to deny with an empty rule list; configure the "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"inserted `tool-policy` row in the profile layer before running tools.
DeepSeek Harness exposes MCP t"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"ools as `mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>`, so an `mcp__*` rule covers the complete MCP namespace."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Current limitations"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- Rules are deployment-global; use multiple Cordis contexts if different agents require different po"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"licy trees.
- The recorded Harness validation baseline is the prerelease `0.1.1-rc.2` registry depen"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"dency set and upstream tag `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2`. CI tests one locked set, not every version in the peer"},{"id":"p38s4","text":" range; the explicit `0.1.1-rc.2` alternative does not include other `0.1.1` prereleases.
- Matching"},{"id":"p38s5","text":" supports one condition per rule, JSON Pointer scalar equality, or string containment. It does not i"},{"id":"p38s6","text":"mplement a general expression language.
- `ask` depends on the Harness approval service and an answe"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"rer. The plugin does not provide a UI or automatically approve a request.
- Policy feedback is inten"},{"id":"p38s8","text":"tionally argument-free; an operator must inspect the original tool call in the Harness session or te"},{"id":"p38s9","text":"lemetry stream.
- The plugin is a per-call pre-dispatch policy, not capability enforcement. Use the "},{"id":"p38s10","text":"Harness sandbox for filesystem, network, and process confinement."}],"truncated":true}
